description:
Web Application Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Web Application Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR. 
 

 Web Application Developer Job Details 
 

 Work with a global team developing a new web portal. High level responsibilities include translating the business needs into code, testing, debugging, and integrating code, and documenting code. This position requires experience writing solutions with AngularJS (v1.4), C#, and Microsoft's Web API 2. Other desirable skills include experience with IIS, unit testing, windows, power shell, automation, SQL Server. In addition, candidate should possess excellent communication, analytical, and problem solving skills, ability work independently and on a team, and deliver quality results. 
 

 Web Application Developer Mandatory Skills 
 

 +SQL Server, and developing stored procedures, triggers, etc. 
 +Responsive design principals, 
 +Unit testing, 
 +Team Foundation Server, 
 +familiarity with industry standards and specifications an advantage 
 +Selenium 
 +Experience with analytical, problem solving, debugging, and optimization estimation skills 
 Years of experience required: 1 year of industry experience in developing JavaScript and C# web applications
 

 Web Application Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP 
 

 Web Application Developer Assignment Length 
 

 11 Months
 

 "Please note that we are not able to work with candidates on H1B Visas or candidates represented by third parties." 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
